name: Daredevil Moto Jump
shortDescription: Channel your inner Evel Knievel! Charge your power, launch off ramps, flip over rows of buses, and collect stars mid-air. Progressive difficulty with more buses each level.

generation.notes: Evel Knievel-inspired motorcycle stunt game with ramp launching, mid-air flips, star collection, bus obstacles, and progressive difficulty. Canvas-based rendering with fire trail particles.
